messages:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — ran the weekly docs sweep and found ~20 pages with externally embedded gists/jsfiddle iframes that either 403 or blow up due to CORS when previewed. example: docs/runtime/onboarding.md embeds gist.github.com/xyz which 403s on load. can someone rehost the code snippets in kb-assets and swap the embeds? cc @Priya Patel @Jordan Lee
Priya Patel: ugh, thanks for flagging. can you paste one concrete path + the offending embed markup so i can repro locally?
Alex Chen: sure — here's one. file: `docs/runtime/onboarding.md` snippet: ```html
<iframe src="https://gist.github.com/username/abcdef.js"></iframe>
```
Jordan Lee: i'll take a first pass on the scan list. is the desired pattern to rehost the raw .js/.html in S3 and then reference via our kb include? or do we prefer inline code blocks in the MDX?
Maya Ortiz: for small runnable snippets i'd prefer rehosting and serving from kb-cdn so we keep the interactive behavior. large examples should be converted to inline fenced code + runnable playground link.
Samir Gupta: also note we should add frontmatter `owner: docs` to any files that get changed, and add alt/descriptive text where the embed was (for accessibility).
docs-bot: automated-scan — found 19 pages with external-embed patterns matching gist/jsfiddle/codepen; severity: medium; report: https://internal-reports/docs-embed-scan/3891234567
Priya Patel: Jordan, tag me on any PRs you open and i'll review quick accessibility bits. Jordan, do you want me to mass-upload the assets once Maya gives the S3 path pattern?
Jordan Lee: yea i'll open a tracking PR then we can split into small PRs per folder. starting with `docs/runtime/` and `docs/onboarding/`.
Maya Ortiz: upload pattern: `aws s3 cp snippet.js s3://kb-assets/docs/runtime/snippets/snippet-<sha>.js --acl private && invalidate-cdn snippet-<sha>` — then replace embed with our host: `https://kb-cdn.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/snippets/snippet-<sha>.js`
Alex Chen: perfect. Jordan — can you also run a quick grep for `iframe` + `gist.github.com` and paste the paths in the PR description so reviewers can eyeball changes?
Jordan Lee: will do. tentative PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — i'll add the file list in the description in the next 10-15m.
Samir Gupta: small note: when updating, prefer using our `{{ include('/snippets/...') }}` macro so future moves are easier. avoids hardcoding CDN urls in the markdown.
Maya Ortiz: +1 to the include macro. i'll prepare an upload script snippet and drop it in the PR description.
Alex Chen: thanks all — marking this as docs-sweep actionable. Maya/Jordan/Priya - can we aim to land the initial batch today? i'll add to the docs sprint board. :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: yep, i'll carve out time this afternoon to review. :raised_hands:
Jordan Lee: picking this up now. ping me here if anything blocks.
Maya Ortiz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/483 (rehost runtime/onboarding snippet + include macro). cc @Alex Chen @Priya Patel
Alex Chen: reviewing now. quick nit — add `owner: docs` to the frontmatter and a 1-line summary of what changed in the commit message. after that feel free to merge.
Jordan Lee: merged 483, opened follow-ups for the remaining files (list in PR 482).
Alex Chen: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll run another sweep after CI finishes to catch any remaining embeds. :sparkles:
